symbol.docstring: Apply a ten percent loyalty discount to the order price.

symbol.name: quote
symbol.docstring: Compute the final order total including discount and shipping.

symbol.name: checkout
symbol.docstring: Place an order: reserve stock, calculate total, charge and notify.
symbol.source:
def checkout(items, stock, token, loyalty=False):
    """Place an order: reserve stock, calculate total, charge and notify."""
    reserve(stock, items)
    amount = quote(items, loyalty)
    receipt = charge(amount, token)
    order = {"items": items, "receipt": receipt}
    order["message"] = confirmation(order)
    return order

symbol.name: submit_order
symbol.docstring: Handle the order endpoint and submit the customer basket.

documents.title: Price calculation
documents.text:
## Price calculation

`quote` computes `subtotal`, applies `discount` and adds `shipping`.
Loyalty customers receive a 10% discount. Free shipping starts at 300000 cents
**after** the discount. Changes to `discount` can affect `quote`, `checkout`, and
`submit_order` through the static call graph.

documents.title: Order lifecycle
documents.text:
## Order lifecycle

`submit_order` calls `checkout`. Checkout reserves inventory, obtains a price quote,
creates a payment receipt and formats a customer confirmation.


documents.title: Payments and refunds
documents.text:
## Payments and refunds

`charge` returns a fictional receipt. `cancel_order` calls `refund`.
No real payment API is used, and no credentials are needed.
